verdict.rationale: Square documents its own Sandbox, an isolated environment for testing Square APIs without touching real data, and separately documents in-person payment APIs (Terminal API, Mobile Payments SDK). However, nothing in the pack shows the Sandbox covering in-person flows specifically, such as a simulated reader, simulated Terminal device, or test card numbers for card-present payments. Missing for 10: evidence of a simulated reader or device for Terminal API/Mobile Payments SDK, documented test cards for in-person payments, end-to-end in-person sandbox walkthrough, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test my in-person integration end-to-end with a simulated reader or test card environment before going live

citations.quote: The Square Sandbox is a free, isolated server environment that allows developers to safely test Square APIs without affecting real data.
Use the Terminal API to connect a custom POS application with a Square Terminal.
Use the Mobile Payments SDK to accept in-person payments in iOS and Android
